# Footprint versus part-number audit -- EEG-CAR-01 Rev C

**Generated by:** `tools/footprint_audit.py`, from `tools/design.py` and `tools/fplib.py`. Not edited by hand.
**Board:** EEG-CAR-01 Rev C  **Date of this run:** 2026-09-08
**Licence:** CC BY-SA 4.0

This is the file behind the phrase "BOM with verified footprints" in the layout-contractor input list of ECO-EEG-030. It checks the package the manufacturer part number encodes against the footprint fitted, the way count of every socket strip against the pads `fplib` actually generates, and -- for the Vishay and Murata part numbers, which carry it -- the value, tolerance, dielectric and voltage rating against the value string a buyer reads. A part number no rule recognises is reported as UNRECOGNISED and is **not** a pass.

| Verdict | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| PASS | 183 | package and value agree with the part number |
| FAIL | 0 | they do not |
| OPEN | 3 | the part number is a class of part and not a qualified part; the footprint cannot be checked against a drawing until one is bought |
| UNRECOGNISED | 0 | no decoding rule matched |
| FEATURE | 25 | fabricated feature: test point, fiducial or mounting hole. Nothing is bought and nothing is placed |

**211 reference designators audited.**

None.

## Datasheets cited

- Bourns MF-MSMF series resettable PTC datasheet: MSMF = 1206
- JST PH series 2.00 mm connector datasheet: B2B-PH-K-S, 2 way, top entry
- Murata GRM/GCM chip monolithic ceramic capacitor part numbering, catalogue C02E, part-numbering page
- Murata chip ferrite bead part numbering and impedance map, catalogue C31E pages 13 and 15
- Nexperia BAV99 (SOT-23) datasheet; BAT54S (SOT-23) datasheet; PESD5V0S2BT (SOT-23) datasheet
- Omron B3F tactile switch datasheet: 6 x 6 mm models are B3F-1000 / -3000 / -6000 (PCB pattern 6.5 x 4.5 mm); 12 x 12 mm models are B3F-4000 / -5000 / -5001
- Samtec SSW series 2.54 mm socket strip datasheet: SSW-1nn-01-G-S, nn = positions, single row, vertical through-hole
- Staubli / Multi-Contact touch-proof 1.5 mm socket to DIN 42802
- TI OPA4376 datasheet SBOS406, package option addendum: PW (TSSOP-14) is the only package the quad is offered in
- TI TLV3201 datasheet SBOS589, package DBV (SOT-23-5)
- Vishay CRCW-e3 thick film chip resistor datasheet, document 20035, part-number table
- Vishay TNPW-e3 thin film chip resistor datasheet, document 28776, part-number table

Nothing in this package has been manufactured or measured, and no part on this list has been bought, sampled or first-articled.
